title: 第335章 三千世界第334章 赌
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 李慕萧眼睛微眯，有些好奇。
“赌什么？”
“赌人性，赌人心。”
楚安芷声音飘忽，目光落在殿外那片被阳光照亮的广场上，回忆着往昔。
“他赌众生皆受欲望驱使，若失去记忆、失去羁绊，便会遵从本能追逐利益的人性。
我赌众生虽有欲望，却亦有情义的人心。”
“人性，人心……”
云孤鸿的声音很轻，像是在品味这两个字的重量。
“那你赌赢了？”
楚安芷转头看着云孤鸿那双写满复杂的眼睛，沉默了片刻，然后慢慢开口：“没有。
赌局还没结束。
他赌众生皆受欲望驱使，我赌众生亦有情义。
这场赌局，从千年前开始，到现在，还没分出胜负。”
楚安芷收回目光，重新看向殿内众人，声音放得更轻了。
“千年前，祂说，众生皆苦，皆因欲望。
若能断欲，便可超脱。
我说，众生虽苦，亦有情义。
情义所在，便是超脱。
祂说，情义不过是欲望的另一种形式。
我说，不是。
祂说，那便赌。
祂赌众生皆受欲望驱使，我赌众生亦有情义。
祂输了，便从神变人，为这片岌岌可危的世界保下生机几许。
我输了，便随着这方世界彻底陨灭，消散虚无。”
殿内寂静无声，思考着这段对话。
“阿弥陀佛，漱玉施主。”
悟心大师清念了一声佛号，说出自己的疑问。
“可否告知贫僧，这方世界为何岌岌可危。
是因为千倾老祖吗？”
楚安芷看着悟心大师那双写满慈悲与疑惑的眼睛，思考片刻。
“是，也不是。”
悟心大师的眉头微微皱起，捻动佛珠的手指停了一瞬。
殿内所有人都看着楚安芷，等待她的下文。
“大师身为佛教大拿定是知道‘三千世界’。”
content_en:
"Betting?"
Li Muxiao narrowed his eyes slightly, curious.
"What bet?"
"Betting on humanity, betting on people's hearts."
Chu Anzhi's voice was erratic, her eyes fell on the square illuminated by the sun outside the palace, recalling the past.
"He bets that all living beings are driven by desire. If they lose their memory and bonds, they will follow the instinct of pursuing profit.
I bet that although all sentient beings have desires, they also have human hearts with love and affection. "
"Human nature, the human heart..."
Yun Guhong's voice was very soft, as if he was savoring the weight of these two words.
"Then you won the bet?"
Chu Anzhi turned to look at Yun Guhong's complicated eyes, was silent for a moment, and then slowly said: "No.
The gamble isn't over yet.
He bets that all living beings are driven by desire, and I bet that all living beings also have feelings.
This bet started thousands of years ago, and up to now, there is still no winner. "
Chu Anzhi withdrew her gaze, looked at everyone in the hall again, and spoke softer.
“Thousands of years ago, He said that all living beings suffer because of desire.
If you can give up desire, you can transcend.
I say that although all living beings are suffering, they also have love and meaning.
The essence of friendship is detachment.
He said that affection is just another form of desire.
I said, no.
He said, let’s bet.
He bets that all sentient beings are driven by desires, and I bet that all sentient beings also have feelings.
When He lost, he transformed from God into a human to save some life for this precarious world.
If I lose, this world will be completely destroyed and disappear into nothingness. "
There was silence in the hall, thinking about this conversation.
"Amitabha, the benefactor of Shuyu."
Master Wu Xin recited the Buddha's name and expressed his question.
"Can you tell this poor monk why this world is in danger?
Is it because of Ancestor Qian Qing? "
Chu Anzhi looked at Master Wu Xin's eyes full of compassion and doubt, and thought for a moment.
"Yes and no."
Master Wu Xin's brows furrowed slightly, and his fingers twirling the beads paused for a moment.
Everyone in the hall looked at Chu Anzhi, waiting for her next words.
"As a great Buddhist master, the master must know the 'Three Thousand Worlds'."
